skola.metaTitle: Dog Training in Spišská Nová Ves – Courses and Behaviour Rehabilitation
skola.metaDescription: Puppy course, adult dog course, individual training and consultation. An intensive 3 Day Camp and a 28-day rehabilitation programme for dogs with behaviour problems.
skola.ogTitle: Dog Training School and Courses | CanisCentral
skola.ogDescription: Training that both dog and owner enjoy. Balance training with clear boundaries and positive motivation.
skola.title: Dog training school
skola.intro: Training that both the dog and the owner enjoy. Positive motivation, a professional approach and results you can see.
skola.coursesNote: We agree the price and the dates around what your dog needs — just get in touch.
skola.c1Desc: For the right start in life. Socialisation, hygiene, coping with stressful situations and building the habits needed for everyday life together. Setting up communication, building trust and laying the foundations of obedience. This is not advice given in a single session — it is a complete plan spanning weeks to months that needs to be done while the dog is still a puppy.
skola.c2Desc: Lessons built around your dog's temperament and needs. The owner learns the right technique and training system using canine training aids; we explain both the theory and the practical exercises at the right intensity.
skola.c3Desc: Focused on a specific problem or on improving how well the dog responds. Behaviour analysis, a one-to-one lesson with the trainer and immediate feedback.
skola.c4Desc: A one-off consultation focused on analysing and diagnosing problem behaviour. We advise how to go on with a puppy or an adult dog, help you understand the causes of the behaviour and show you how to guide your dog, and yourself, with confidence.
skola.pr1Lead: Theory, practice and a real connection between handler and dog.
skola.pr1Body: Suitable for any owner who wants to move forward with professional trainers. Three days are enough to establish calm and confidence in any situation you meet with your four-legged friend. You will change the way you train and the way you connect with your dog — and with that, your relationship.
skola.pr1P4: A complete plan tailored to your dog's temperament and behaviour
skola.pr1Note: Balance training — balanced, harmonious training built on positive motivation (praise and reward) with clear boundaries, where the dog understands us better and we understand the dog. It is effective, readable and safe.
skola.pr2Lead: For dogs with behaviour problems — aggression, reactivity, fear, separation anxiety and others.
skola.pr2Body: Drawing on many years of experience and an individual approach, we set a daily routine and a precise training plan for your dog. Along the way we change what the dog values and how it thinks, give it positive experiences and in doing so remove its existing bad habits and problem behaviour.
skola.pr2P2: Socialisation with unfamiliar dogs in a different environment
skola.pr2P3: Socialisation in town with unfamiliar people
skola.pr2Note: Our shared goal is that you enjoy calm walks again, without stress and tension.
skola.ctaText: Write or call us — we will agree on a date and on which course makes the most sense for your dog.

about.metaTitle: About Us – Canis Central, Spišská Nová Ves, Since 1991
about.metaDescription: Professional dog care since 1991. A certified grooming salon, a dog hotel, the FCI-registered CEVARO kennel and natural supplements by Longevity for Animals.
about.ogDescription: More than 40 years with dogs, the CEVARO kennel since 1984, working with the vet MVDr. Jiří Urbánek.
about.title: Canis Central —
about.intro: Welcome to the online shop that continues the long-standing work of the Canis Central store in Spišská Nová Ves. More than 40 years with dogs — and we still enjoy it just as much.
about.story1: Our purpose is to make genuinely effective products easier for dog and cat owners to get hold of. Four-legged members of the family deserve the best — and we want to help them live longer, more active and healthier lives.
about.story2: Unlike us, dogs cannot change their environment or their eating habits. They are exposed to stress, pollution, poor food and too little exercise — exactly as people are. Owners often miss the first signs of health problems, simply because they do not know what to look for.
about.story3: Our aim is to make caring for a dog easier for its owner — and to give dogs the prospect of a longer, healthier life. If we cannot remove the effects of environment, diet and genetics, let us at least help them cope with those challenges better.
about.m1: The CEVARO kennel is founded — breeding German Shepherds with health and character in mind
about.m2: The Canis Central store opens in Spišská Nová Ves — everything for your companions
about.m3: Expansion with the certified Canis Cutting salon and a certified dog hotel
about.m4: Launch of the caniscentral.sk online shop and work with MVDr. Jiří Urbánek on canine longevity
about.v1Desc: Behind every service there is genuine passion — not a business, but a way of life. To us, dogs are family.
about.v2Desc: The CEVARO kennel (1984) puts health and character before looks. Genetic testing, FCI registration.
about.v3Desc: We work with MVDr. Jiří Urbánek, MBA, M.Ed. — a vet focused on preventive medicine and canine longevity (Longevity for Animals).
about.v4Desc: Both the Canis Cutting salon and the dog hotel are certified. We know what we are doing, and we have the papers to prove it.
about.vetText: We work with MVDr. Jiří Urbánek, MBA, M.Ed. — a vet focused on preventive medicine and research into the factors behind canine longevity (Longevity for Animals). He publishes in professional journals and promotes the idea of a long, healthy life for animals in the media.
about.vetNote: There is still a long way to go. But the health and contentment of animals that depend on our care is worth it.
about.vetQuote: “You can set out on this road together with us.”
about.contactServices: Store · Dog hotel · Canis Cutting salon
about.contactNote: The Canis Central store in Spišská Nová Ves — the online shop is an extension of services built up over many years.
